author: Claude (acting Darwin lead). Prepared ahead of the D4 diagnostic; not proposed for a boot until the mechanism is runtime-confirmed and this change is independently reviewed.
purpose: Candidate fix for reports/sprint-010/shared-shell-first-app-sigkill-spawnattr-analysis-001.json: posix_spawnattr_init zeroes the whole 248-byte attribute struct before setting its defaults, as the pinned xnu libsyscall __posix_spawnattr_init effectively does field by field.
patch_effect: Adds memset(*psattrp, 0, sizeof(struct _posix_spawnattr)) after a successful malloc and before the existing defaults. No other line changes; no export or CMake change.
recipe_scope: Same flake and pin as build-libsystem-pagesize.nix (which produced the canonical 8ff49e0c), with the same vm_page_size patch plus this one.
build_log: runs/m1-desktop-010/libsystem-spawnattr-build-001/build.log (exit 0). build-attempt0.log is a first try that failed before evaluation because nix-command was not enabled.

comparison_with_canonical_8ff49e0c.sections: Only __text differs: start 0x51e0 -> 0x51cc, size 0x2673dc -> 0x2673f0 (+0x14). ld64 back-aligns __TEXT, so every function before posix_spawn.o moves down 0x14; _malloc and later code keep their addresses. All other sections keep address and size.
comparison_with_canonical_8ff49e0c.normalized_text_diff: 618519 vs 618524 instructions after resolving every branch and adrp-pair target to symbol+offset. The only differences are in _posix_spawnattr_init: five added instructions (ldr; ldr; mov x2,#0xf8; mov w1,#0; bl _memset) and its two branches to the epilogue moving from +0x1cc to +0x1e0.
comparison_with_canonical_8ff49e0c.raw_byte_differences: About 601k bytes differ because of the 0x14 layout shift and the data pointers that follow it; not a semantic change by the comparison above.

other_dylibs_in_output: The output also contains usr/lib/dyld, libSystem.dylib and system/; they were not compared here.
not_claimed: that this fixes the first-app SIGKILL
